dev_rules.candidate: only if an input scale was chosen: run K1, K2, K3, C1R, M0 and M1 through the full sequence on every DEV world. Rank K1, K2, K3 by (1) the number of DEV worlds SEQUENCE_HELD, descending; (2) the median over DEV worlds of final_mean_nmse, ascending; (3) extra_persistent_bytes, ascending; (4) analytic hot-path extra operations per step, ascending; (5) the order K1, K2, K3. The first is the selected candidate. C1R, M0 and M1 are never selected; no candidate is excluded for a zero count
dev_rules.nothing_else: DEV chooses only the hidden gain and the selected candidate. Steps, rate, rows, angle, input scale, planes, hyperparameters, procedure constants, thresholds, ablations and gates are fixed here
dev_rules.task: controls only (M0, M1, O, WSTAR; no candidate, no reference): for hidden_gain in hidden_gain_grid in order, on every DEV world, check V1 realizability (WSTAR nmse <= 1e-20 on every experience), V2 real forgetting (M0 SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of DEV worlds, median over DEV worlds of M0 final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 0.5 and median A_end_ratio >= 10), V3 novelty (every DEV world and every stage s in B, C, D: nmse_s(O_prev) >= 0.5), V4 learnability (M0 LEARNED_s at every stage of every DEV world), V5 joint solvability (M1 SEQUENCE_HELD in every DEV world), V6 capacity (every DEV world, every stage: the stage ceiling has nmse <= 1e-6 on every experience seen so far). Choose the first hidden_gain satisfying V1-V6. If none does: TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV; the DEV record holds the control results; no candidate or reference is run; no freeze; a revised design is a new version
